senses.gloss: m. pl. (pl. of ξεστός or of sextarius, transposed) sextarii (one sextarius = 1/16 of a modius).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 5:6:6">Y. B. Mets. V, 10ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כגון אילין … מתרתין ק׳ … ק׳</he> as those who advance the money with which to buy to those who sail to (do business at) the races, at a share in the profits of two or three sextarii for each modius; v. <cite ref="S01331"><he>קָלִיט</he></cite>.
